Used by polyflow_temporal/quickjs_engines.py (WasmQuickJS) under wasmtime. Only
the .wasm is used: none of the package's JavaScript glue. Every import the
module declares (6 in `env`, 6 in `wasi_snapshot_preview1`) is a stub defined
in quickjs_engines.py; nothing reaches the host.
